abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: guts
abilities.effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: hustle
abilities.effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

kanto.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

original-johto.flavorText: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It search­ es wide areas for food.

hoenn.flavorText: A RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

original-unova.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

updated-unova.flavorText: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

kalos.flavorText: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Raticate’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

original-alola.flavorText: Its disposition is far more violent than its looks would suggest. Don’t let your hand get too close to its face, as it could bite your hand clean off.

updated-alola.flavorText: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
